body.p1: I'm a Computer Science student and software engineer who loves turning ideas into reliable and scalable products.
body.p2: I'm proficient in PHP, Go, Python, React Native, Vue, Node.js, UniApp, and H5, and I enjoy both backend and frontend work.
body.p3: My key interests include building web applications, blockchain solutions, and practical bridges between on-chain and off-chain systems.
body.p4: Whenever possible, I enjoy building projects with PHP and modern frameworks like Vue.

card.line1: Hi everyone! I'm Beile Zhang, currently living in Annandale, Sydney.
card.line3: I'm currently pursuing a Master of Computer Science (Advanced Entry) at the University of Sydney (2026–2028).
card.line4: Previously, I completed a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Durham University (College of St Hild & St Bede), graduating on 3 July 2024 with Class II Division 1 (Honours) and an AI-focused dissertation.

chatify.title: CTF Demo – 2026
chatify.description: An automated AI red-teaming and CTF-style experiment built with scripted conversations in Codex. It targets promptairlines.com, bypasses front-end limits to talk directly to backend APIs, reverse-engineers system behavior, fully logs interactions for strategy tuning, and achieved 100% success rate in the test environment.

bitsOfCode.title: Telebot & CMS System – 2026
bitsOfCode.description: A lightweight Telegram-style bot and admin CMS built with ThinkPHP + Node.js on Ubuntu/MySQL. It supports user management, system notifications, auto commission settlement, task publishing, and recharge/withdraw flows, with a modular ~40MB codebase and hands-on deployment/performance tuning from 2025.

editorIo.title: Freetrade Tribute – 2026
editorIo.description: A clean, Vue-based landing-page demo inspired by the UK stock trading platform Freetrade. It focuses on componentized architecture, responsive layout, and information hierarchy for fintech products, mainly as a UI and interaction design practice.

plantAi.title: Cross-Border E-commerce App – 2025
plantAi.description: A cross-border e-commerce project where I worked remotely as a full-stack developer. The frontend is built with React Native + Expo to ship a unified codebase across Web, Android, and iOS, while the backend uses the client’s private stack (Go or Java). My main work included refactoring the frontend architecture, handling cross-platform compatibility, and optimizing state management and API integration.

aiForSocialGood.title: ETHFI DApp – 2025
aiForSocialGood.description: A team-built on-chain application where I owned the frontend in Vue 3 and collaborated with a Go backend team. I solved WebView compatibility issues, integrated crypto wallet APIs, implemented DApp interaction flows, and independently designed the UI, strengthening my blockchain frontend and collaboration skills.

faceEmotion.title: Retirement Finance Platform – 2025
faceEmotion.description: A small pension and wealth management platform where I independently delivered the backend system and launch in 15 days. The backend uses Workerman with a UniApp frontend and includes purchasing, recharge/withdrawal, check-in, news/announcements, form management, and limited-time promotions, built under strict client privacy requirements.

openclaw.title: OpenClaw Deployment Write-up
openclaw.subtitle: Server setup, install script, and security notes.
openclaw.p1: Prepare a server and connect to it (e.g. via SSH).
openclaw.p2: In the terminal run: curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash, and follow the script to complete installation.
openclaw.p3: Complete the configuration as guided: prepare your Bot (Telegram) key and the corresponding model API key, then test the connection.
openclaw.p4: Ensure the gateway is open and that OpenClaw’s service port is only accessible by you; otherwise there are security and fund loss risks.
